name: @projexlight/sdk-engagement
summary: Encounter primitives: every interaction with a customer (sales call, support session, onboarding meeting, field visit) is an Encounter with participants + a state machine. Pairs with sdk-crm for the contact + sdk-conversation for the messaging substrate. Every SDK that 'serves a customer' attaches its work to an encounter so reporting + audit have a single grouping key.

endpoints.description: Create an encounter (kind + scheduled time + participants).
Advance encounter state (scheduled → in-progress → completed / no-show / cancelled).
Grant temporary access (one-time agent join, customer self-serve viewer).
List active grants for an encounter.
Add a structured note (typed by purpose: discovery / objection / next-step).

events.name: engagement.encounter.completed.v1
events.description: Encounter completed normally; downstream SDKs key billing + commission on this.

events.name: engagement.encounter.no_show.v1
events.description: Encounter ended without participant; no-show analytics.

events.name: engagement.grant.issued.v1
events.description: Temporary access grant issued (one-time agent join).

models.description: Per-encounter row: kind, state, contact_id, scheduled_at, started_at, completed_at.
Per-(encounter, persona) row: role (host/attendee/observer), joined_at, left_at.
Per-grant row: kind (agent_join / viewer / co-edit), issued_to, expires_at.

hooks.name: scheduleEncounter
hooks.description: Create a scheduled encounter; participants invited via sdk-notification.

hooks.name: completeEncounter
hooks.description: Transition in-progress → completed; carries summary + outcome.

hooks.name: issueGrant
hooks.description: Issue a temporary access grant (e.g. an agent joining a customer's session).

hooks.name: addParticipant
hooks.description: Add a participant mid-encounter (supervisor joining a triage call).

scenarios.title: AE schedules a demo encounter + invites the customer
scenarios.when_to_use: Outbound or inbound discovery — AE schedules; sdk-notification sends the invite; connector-zoom creates the meeting if configured.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Encounter row in scheduled state; emits .scheduled.v1. connector-zoom creates the meeting; invite SMS/email sent.

scenarios.title: Supervisor joins an in-progress support call
scenarios.when_to_use: Escalation — senior rep joins to assist; we add them as a participant mid-encounter for accurate timeline + commission attribution.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Participant row written; emits .participant.joined.v1. Timeline shows senior joining at the correct timestamp.

scenarios.title: Issue a viewer grant so the customer can replay the recording
scenarios.when_to_use: Post-encounter, AE wants the customer to be able to watch the Zoom recording without a ProjexCloud account.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Grant_url returned (signed JWT). Email sent. Prospect can access the recording without a full account.

scenarios.title: Encounter completion triggers commission projection
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive — engagement.encounter.completed.v1 with kind='demo-completed' counts toward the AE's quarterly demo target. sdk-projection rolls up.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Counter advanced; reflected in commission dashboard. Audit chain pins the encounter as the source.

scenarios.title: Auto no-show after the grace window
scenarios.when_to_use: Encounter scheduled for 15:00; nobody starts it by 15:00 + ENGAGEMENT_NO_SHOW_GRACE_MIN (15) — system flips to no-show + emits .no_show.v1.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Stale encounter marked no_show; emits .no_show.v1. Marketing's no-show retargeting workflow picks it up.

compliance_posture.notes: Encounter rows + participants are the GDPR Art-30 record-of-processing for any customer-facing interaction. Healthcare tenants use this as the patient-encounter primitive — sdk-consent + sdk-evidence attach to encounter_id.
